summary: Sibling of John's great-grandmother Florence Pringle (great-grand-aunt of John).
bio:
Child of Addison F. Pringle and Catherine E. Heffernan, born about 1906, listed in the 1910 census (Plymouth/Larksville) household. No further research done.

FamilySearch records Helen R. Pringle's marriage at Wilkes-Barre on 16 Sep 1931 to William J. Toole (1905-1976). At the time she lived at 28 Huston Street, the address her sister Florence gave at her own 1926 marriage. FamilySearch places the Tooles at Marion, Ohio, in 1940 and gives Helen's death date as 13 Apr 1992 ([R4-S1]). Her younger sister Katherine married a Daniel F. Toole.
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh (1910 Plymouth census list of Catherine Heffernan Pringle's children)
